mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of RSAFS and UNRATE does not correlate with strong consumer demand and labor market health.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous 3 months signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with strong job growth.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 6 months signals robust economic growth and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in 6 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of GDPC1 and UNRATE does not correlate with robust economic growth and labor market health.
